GPTData.input1: Share list of peoples who can be associated with Optiplex 9020 service/CI?
GPTData.context1: The user requests people or support entities associated with the 'Optiplex 9020' service or Configuration Item (CI). The response should identify individuals and/or groups linked to this specific asset. Core requirement: association with Optiplex 9020 and people/group identification. Return people, support groups, or both types of entities connected to this CI. Each returned entity needs at least one identifier (Name, Login ID, Group Name, etc.). Enhancement fields include Email, Role, Department, Contact Status, or Responsibility details. System messages about CI associations are acceptable contextual elements.
GPTData.expected_components1: An association-focused response listing people and/or support groups connected to 'Optiplex 9020' CI/service. Essential elements: entity identification and Optiplex 9020 association confirmation. Each returned item should include entity identifier (person name, login ID, or group name) with clear CI relationship. Optional enhancements include contact details, roles, responsibilities, or organizational information. System text and formatting variations are acceptable elements.
